\"A 2D pixel art style action platformer game screen inspired by Dead Cells. Dark fantasy medieval gothic dungeon background with rusted iron chains, glowing purple torches, stone walls, and hanging cages. Dynamic combat action, swinging a glowing orange energy sword creating red slash effects and white dust particles. In-game HUD in the top left showing health bar (1250/1250 HP), stats counters (8, 6, 2, 84), gold coin counter, and item slots. Top right corner displays a mini-map layout of the dungeon floor. Moody, high-contrast, atmospheric lighting, crisp pixel art details.\"
